name: agronova-poultry-dashboard
description: AgroNova Poultry AI IoT monitoring platform monorepo

scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @agronova/telemetry-schema build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @agronova/api --filter @agronova/web --filter @agronova/simulator dev
